turns.question: How big was our customer base in Turkey at the end of September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" is ambiguous, so here is each figure under its metric's label. Customers to date (everyone signed up by 2026-09-30, a running total over all time) in Turkey: 5 customers at the end of September 2026. For September 2026 alone, Signups (customers who signed up in the month) in Turkey were 1 and Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order) were 2. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
